comparison.objective: Peel protective film while holding an acrylic sheet down and discard the film.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, tab pinch, controlled peeling trajectory, and deformable-proxy handling; no rotary adjustment or lock.
comparison.success_condition: All four strips peeled into the basket without tab tear or excessive sheet translation/tilt.
comparison.reason: Counterholding is shared generically, but the tested ability is peel-force management across a breakable bond.
